title: FAITH, HOPE, LOVE – THE THREE PILLARS OF HOLINESS

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.” (1 Corinthians 13:13)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Holiness is not an event that happens in one day; it is a journey. This spiritual journey rests upon three divine pillars: Faith, Hope, and Love.

FAITH:
“Without faith it is impossible to please God.”  (Hebrews 11:6) Faith is trusting the unseen God and obeying His voice. When Abraham heard God’s call, he stepped out “not knowing where he was going.”  (Hebrews 11:8) Thus, “it was counted unto him as righteousness.” (Romans 4:3)
Anything done without faith even if it looks good is sin in God’s sight. (Romans 14:23)
Faith is the foundation of holiness.
It brings us into obedience, and obedience shapes us into the likeness of Christ.
HOPE:
Hope is the confident expectation that God will surely work. It is the strong anchor of our soul.
Faith without hope becomes weak, but faith joined with hope grows into true holiness. Hope lifts us out of sin and brings us into the brightness of God’s grace. Saying, “God will sanctify me,” is the hope that releases us from bondage.
Hope gives strength to endure, courage to continue, and joy to look ahead.
LOVE:
Love is the highest expression of holiness. Faith and hope without love become empty and powerless. “Love covers a multitude of sins.”
(1 Peter 4:8). It was the love of Jesus that covered our sins; His blood cleansed us, and His righteousness clothed us. Love leads us into sacrificial living and helps us reflect God’s own image. Through love, we grow in maturity and truth. (Ephesians 4:15)
Love perfects what faith begins and what hope sustains.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Faith sees the invisible, Hope expects the incredible, and Love achieves the impossible.” ( Corrie ten Boom)

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, strengthen my faith, renew my hope, and sanctify me through Your divine love. Help me reflect Your holy character in my daily life.
Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: lifts you to the heights of holiness.
